title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a second example car to the Session 1 app
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 app has one car whose speed starts at zero; learners ask what happens with a car that starts already moving.

## Context
The slope-and-area idea is the same, but a starting speed makes the area picture richer.

## Expected outcome
A preset or slider for the starting speed in `sessions/session-01/app.html`, with the readout still correct.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Readout matches a hand calculation
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: Romberg integration
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. Students ask how to get far more accuracy from the same number of function evaluations as Simpson's rule.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: Gaussian quadrature
body:
## Problem
Session 3 uses equally spaced sample points only.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5: well-chosen points give much smaller errors.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app that compare Gauss-Legendre with Simpson for the same number of evaluations.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Roadmap checkpoint demonstrated
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: live derivative, integral and convergence plot
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a function with its derivative and integral drawn live and a convergence plot; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Orders 1, 2, 2 and 4 visible on a log-log plot
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
